sentences.en: The bus service is not good between nine and ten.
sentences.zh: 9点到10点之间的公交服务不太好。

sentences.en: We are always aiming at improving the quality of service.
sentences.zh: 我们一直致力于提高服务质量。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to say, but the service isn't very good.
sentences.zh: 抱歉地说，这项服务并不是很好。

senses.zh: 服务性的；耐用的；服现役的
